nina_marketing: Heads-up: release day tomorrow. Need final changelog (marketing-friendly), docs permalink, benchmark narrative link, webinar CTA, and HubSpot routing details.
elaine_pm: scope locked to perf + streaming fixes. i'll post a 2-line changelog in 5.
tyler_eng: canary window set for 11:00 PST, 15m canary, 30m observability hold. marketing please hold public posts until 11:50 PST.
sophia_docs: compiling docs bundle now (migration note + examples). will publish prod permalink after deploy finishes. staging link: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/rel-2-1-preview
maria_ops: i'll wire the HubSpot webhook after deploy success. need tag name from marketing.
sam_sdr: routing preference: enterprise -> SDR-A, trials -> automated nurture. also want demo signup webhooks to #sales-inbound.
nina_marketing: tag name: `launch-autumn-2-1`. changelog bullets (draft):
- ~15% lower per-token cost for typical embedding workloads
- streaming reliability improvements for long-chat sessions
impact sentence: "Lower unit cost + steadier streaming means teams can scale inference with fewer surprises."
tyler_eng: 15% is accurate for our common embedding profile; include "typical workloads" qualifier.
sophia_docs: prod docs permalink now live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide - includes migration snippet and API diff. benchmark gist: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/rel-2-1-benchmarks
nina_marketing: great. webinar confirmation needs: docs permalink, slides link, demo notebook, and 1-line changelog. sophia, can you add a curl snippet for the demo?
sophia_docs: added `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` to slides. uploading slides now.
maria_ops: webhook ready: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-2-1; will enable on successful deploy.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 11:00 PST. Posting updates to #release-war-room.
title_note: (typo) ignore
tyle_eng: monitoring policy: if p99 > baseline +20% or errors spike, we will pause and roll back.
deploy-bot: Canary succeeded at 11:12 PST. Observability hold until 11:42 PST. Payload sample: { "event":"release", "version":"2.1", "status":"canary-success" }
nina_marketing: scheduling social + email for 11:50 PST. will wait 30m post-canary as agreed. please ping here if anything looks off.
sam_sdr: HubSpot workflow updated and webhook tested. routing live.
elaine_pm: final check - confirm docs link in registration email is https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide
sophia_docs: confirmed.
nina_marketing: thanks everyone. drafting social copy now and will post for PR in 15. :rocket:
